test.title: A famous person you would like to meet

document.cue: Describe a famous person you would like to meet.

text: The person I'd most like to meet is Gennady Golovkin, the boxer from Karaganda. Most people in Kazakhstan know him simply as GGG, and for years he was one of the best middleweight fighters in the world.

I first heard about him when I was about twelve. My father used to wake me up at five in the morning to watch his fights, which were broadcast live from America, and the whole family would sit in front of the TV in our pyjamas, shouting at the screen. He also won a silver medal at the Olympics in 2004, before he became a professional.

If I met him, I wouldn't ask about his famous fights. I'd rather ask how he dealt with pressure — the feeling that a whole country is watching you — and what he did on the days when he didn't want to train. I'd also like to know what advice he would give to young athletes from small towns, because he started in a very ordinary sports club.

The main reason I admire him is his attitude. Even at the peak of his career, he always spoke calmly and respectfully about his opponents and never showed off. For me, he proves that you can be extremely successful without being arrogant.
Meeting him would be a dream come true, especially for my father.

tips.en: In our pyjamas, shouting at the screen creates a lively picture.
tips.kk: In our pyjamas, shouting at the screen — тірі көрініс.
tips.ru: In our pyjamas, shouting at the screen — живая картинка.
tips.example: in our pyjamas, shouting at the screen

tips.en: I wouldn't ask about … I'd rather ask … shows a thoughtful choice.
tips.kk: I wouldn't ask about … I'd rather ask … — салиқалы тақырып таңдау.
tips.ru: I wouldn't ask about … I'd rather ask … — зрелый выбор темы.
tips.example: I'd rather ask how he dealt with pressure

note.en: “At the most successful time of his working life”.

phrases.text: at the peak of his career

note.en: Who the person is — name, home town and why he is famous.
note.kk: Бұл кім — есімі, қаласы және немен танымал.
note.ru: Кто это — имя, город и чем известен.

note.en: How the speaker knows him — a family story about early-morning fights.
note.kk: Қайдан біледі — таңғы жекпе-жектер туралы отбасылық оқиға.
note.ru: Откуда знает — семейная история с утренними боями.

note.en: What the speaker would ask — unexpected questions instead of obvious ones.
note.kk: Не сұрар еді — айқын сұрақтардың орнына күтпеген сұрақтар.
note.ru: О чём спросил бы — неожиданные вопросы вместо очевидных.

note.en: Why the speaker wants to meet him — his character, not only his wins.
note.kk: Неге кездескісі келеді — жеңістер ғана емес, мінезі.
note.ru: Почему хочет встретиться — характер, а не только победы.

note.en: A warm ending that returns to the father.
note.ru: Тёплая концовка с отсылкой к отцу.
